title: Promos
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office grapples with the revealing promos of a documentary about their workplace, exposing private moments and secret footage that unsettle many employees. Phyllis is caught masturbating in the office while listening to 50 Shades of Grey, leading to awkward interventions by Dwight and Andy. Dwight navigates complications in his relationship with Esther Ruger and a tractor lease deal involving her father. Meanwhile, Jim encounters Ryan Howard pitching a baseball-themed superhero screenplay. The office members react with a mix of humor, concern, and conflict as they confront the implications of the documentary's exposure, including worries about political fallout and personal privacy.

main_threads.thread: The office reacts to the documentary promos revealing secret and private footage, causing discomfort, conflict, and reflection on their lack of privacy over the years.
